$comment: In-app Home dashboard cards. These are separate from operating-system widgets and from homeCardOrder, which still orders pinned prayers on Pray.
macOS: Retains its native library and Today workflow; shared content and reading fixes still apply.

homeWidgetOrder.encoding: Newline-separated widget IDs in display order.
homeWidgetOrder.explicitEmpty: No cards. Keep Add Widget available; do not silently restore defaults.
homeWidgetOrder.normalization: Preserve known IDs' first occurrence, ignore unknown IDs and duplicates. Add appends; removal deletes only that card's selection.

homePhotoPath.scope: Device-local private photo copy; never a shared gallery permission or cloud-synced external path.
homePhotoPath.replacement: Validate and install the new private image before retiring the previous private copy. A failed import preserves the existing photo.
homePhotoPath.removal: Remove only the app-owned copy when removing the photo or photo card. Keep the source gallery photo intact.

homeWidgetCollapsedIds.encoding: Newline-separated widget IDs; known first occurrences only.
homeWidgetCollapsedIds.scope: Device-persisted compact/large state, independent of visibility/order.
homeWidgetCollapsedIds.behavior: Compact cards retain heading, source summary and open action; large cards show full content and optional picture.

homeWidgetGraphicPaths.encoding: JSON object known widget ID -> app-private device-local image path.
homeWidgetGraphicPaths.replacement: Validate and install the new private image before retiring the previous private copy. A failed import preserves the existing photo.
homeWidgetGraphicPaths.removal: Remove only the app-owned private copy. Clear its mapping without deleting the original photo or another card image.

cards.readings: Complete localized appointed citations, in reverseReadingsOrder presentation when enabled, linking to Daily Readings for the shared Home/Readings civil date and selected calendar.
cards.popeIntention: Title and prose from the canonical Pope intention table for the selected month.
cards.calendar: Every published date in the selected calendar is marked; up to three dots plus full accessible event count. Monday-first civil Gregorian grid, true RTL. Supplied observances are independently clickable, with parent fallback for older data. Exact-language descriptions and credits appear in a native detail sheet/dialog, with Readings for this Date action preserving window state.
cards.photo: A chosen gallery image, stored in app-private storage, with choose/replace/remove controls and recoverable errors.
cards.reminders: Actual enabled saved-prayer and daily reading/saint reminders, formatted as local wall-clock times. Manage opens existing native reminder settings/editors.
cards.scripture: Scripture of the Day: first Gospel appointment in canonical source order, else first appointment. Use existing exact citation mapping, selected edition and offline text loader; missing dates/text remain explicit. Open the existing Bible reader.
cards.reflection: Exact-language, selected-calendar/date reflection sections from the separate provisional Mission source, retaining source credit. Missing source prose is explicit; no invented reflections.
cards.feast: Localized feast/rank plus exact-language sourced descriptions and credit where available. Repeated parent feast headings are omitted; source-supplied sections render as dedicated headed blocks in each rite's own order. Incomplete section coverage keeps the full source prose. Missing description/date has a localized explicit state.

navigation: Phone/tablet tabs are Home, Pray, Readings and Search. Windows opens Home in its library window. Community prayers are reached from Search, replacing the separate Browse/Community navigation destination.
date: Reuse the existing window-local civil selection and calendar/Pascha settings; follow the local day until browsing. Home shortcuts preserve the selected day. Operating-system Today/calendar widgets retain their documented current-day activation behavior.
localization: All new labels and empty/error states ship in en, he, ar, ru, tl/fil, fr, it and uk; Hebrew and Arabic use genuine RTL.
cardArtwork: Home cards can add/change/remove private images. Pray/library prayer cards resolve authored gallery artwork through the owning pack; no native duplicate artwork assets.
